name: P1 — Product-Led Revenue Qualification & Sales Handoff

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.ingress_rejections (
    event_id,
    event_type,
    product_user_id,
    workspace_id,
    rejection_reason,
    validation_errors,
    rejected_payload
)
VALUES (
    $1,
    $2,
    $3,
    $4,
    $5,
    $6::jsonb,
    $7::jsonb
)
RETURNING
    id,
    event_id,
    event_type,
    rejection_reason,
    rejected_at;

WITH inserted AS (
    INSERT INTO public.product_events (
        event_id,
        event_type,
        occurred_at,
        product_user_id,
        workspace_id,
        event_properties,
        received_at
    )
    VALUES (
        $1,
        $2,
        $3,
        $4,
        $5,
        $6::jsonb,
        $7
    )
    ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING event_id
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted)
            THEN 'inserted'
        ELSE 'duplicate'
    END AS event_status,
    $1::text AS event_id;

INSERT INTO public.processing_attempts (
    event_id,
    attempt_number,
    processing_status
)
VALUES (
    $1,
    (
        SELECT COALESCE(MAX(attempt_number), 0) + 1
        FROM public.processing_attempts
        WHERE event_id = $1
    ),
    'processing'
)
RETURNING
    id,
    event_id,
    attempt_number,
    processing_status,
    started_at;

SELECT
    pe.event_id,
    pe.event_type,
    pe.occurred_at,
    pe.product_user_id,
    pe.workspace_id,
    pe.event_properties,
    pe.received_at,

    pa.id AS processing_attempt_id,
    pa.attempt_number,
    pa.processing_status

FROM public.product_events pe

JOIN public.processing_attempts pa
    ON pa.event_id = pe.event_id

WHERE pe.event_id = $1
  AND pa.id = $2;

SELECT
    pe.event_id,
    pe.event_type,
    pe.occurred_at,
    pe.product_user_id,
    pe.workspace_id,
    pe.event_properties,
    pe.received_at,

    pe.processing_attempt_id,
    pe.attempt_number,
    pe.processing_status,

    user_map.hubspot_record_id AS hubspot_contact_id,
    user_map.resolution_method AS contact_resolution_method,

    workspace_map.hubspot_record_id AS hubspot_company_id,
    workspace_map.resolution_method AS company_resolution_method

FROM (
    SELECT
        $1::text AS event_id,
        $2::text AS event_type,
        $3::timestamptz AS occurred_at,
        $4::text AS product_user_id,
        $5::text AS workspace_id,
        $6::jsonb AS event_properties,
        $7::timestamptz AS received_at,
        $8::bigint AS processing_attempt_id,
        $9::integer AS attempt_number,
        $10::text AS processing_status
) pe

LEFT JOIN public.identity_map user_map
    ON user_map.entity_type = 'product_user'
   AND user_map.product_id = pe.product_user_id

LEFT JOIN public.identity_map workspace_map
    ON workspace_map.entity_type = 'workspace'
   AND workspace_map.product_id = pe.workspace_id;

INSERT INTO public.identity_map (
    entity_type,
    product_id,
    hubspot_object_type,
    hubspot_record_id,
    resolution_method
)
VALUES (
    'product_user',
    $1,
    'contact',
    $2,
    'stable_id'
)
ON CONFLICT (entity_type, product_id)
DO UPDATE SET
    hubspot_record_id = EXCLUDED.hubspot_record_id,
    resolution_method = EXCLUDED.resolution_method
RETURNING
    entity_type,
    product_id,
    hubspot_object_type,
    hubspot_record_id,
    resolution_method;

SELECT
    workspace_id,
    product_intent_score,
    product_intent_state,
    commercial_intent_detected,
    important_signal_summary,
    latest_meaningful_signal_at,
    intent_window_start,
    calculated_at,
    model_version
FROM public.account_signal_state
WHERE workspace_id = $1;

SELECT
    event_type,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM public.product_events
WHERE workspace_id = $1
  AND occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY event_type
ORDER BY event_type;

UPDATE public.account_signal_state
SET
    product_intent_score = $2,
    product_intent_state = $3,
    commercial_intent_detected = $4,
    important_signal_summary = $5,
    intent_window_start = NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days',
    calculated_at = NOW(),
    model_version = $6
WHERE workspace_id = $1
RETURNING
    workspace_id,
    product_intent_score,
    product_intent_state,
    commercial_intent_detected,
    important_signal_summary,
    intent_window_start,
    calculated_at,
    model_version;

UPDATE public.processing_attempts
SET
    processing_status = 'completed',
    qualification_state = $2,
    handoff_status = $3,
    completed_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING
    id,
    event_id,
    attempt_number,
    processing_status,
    qualification_state,
    handoff_status,
    completed_at;

UPDATE public.processing_attempts
SET
    processing_status = 'completed',
    qualification_state = 'handoff_blocked',
    handoff_status = 'review_required',
    completed_at = NOW()
WHERE id = (
    SELECT id
    FROM public.processing_attempts
    WHERE event_id = $1
    ORDER BY attempt_number DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
RETURNING
    id,
    event_id,
    attempt_number,
    processing_status,
    qualification_state,
    handoff_status,
    completed_at;

UPDATE public.processing_attempts
SET
    processing_status = 'review_required',
    qualification_state = 'needs_review',
    handoff_status = 'review_required',
    failure_type = 'identity_not_found',
    failure_reason = 'Product user could not be resolved to a HubSpot Contact',
    completed_at = NOW()
WHERE id = (
    SELECT id
    FROM public.processing_attempts
    WHERE event_id = $1
    ORDER BY attempt_number DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
RETURNING
    id,
    event_id,
    attempt_number,
    processing_status,
    qualification_state,
    handoff_status,
    failure_type,
    failure_reason,
    completed_at;

UPDATE public.processing_attempts
SET
    processing_status = 'completed',
    qualification_state = 'handed_off',
    handoff_status = 'completed',
    completed_at = NOW()
WHERE id = (
    SELECT id
    FROM public.processing_attempts
    WHERE event_id = $1
    ORDER BY attempt_number DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
RETURNING
    id,
    event_id,
    attempt_number,
    processing_status,
    qualification_state,
    handoff_status,
    completed_at;

UPDATE public.processing_attempts
SET
    processing_status = 'review_required',
    qualification_state = 'needs_review',
    handoff_status = 'review_required',
    failure_type = 'identity_ambiguous',
    failure_reason = 'Multiple HubSpot Contacts matched the product identity',
    completed_at = NOW()
WHERE id = (
    SELECT id
    FROM public.processing_attempts
    WHERE event_id = $1
    ORDER BY attempt_number DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
RETURNING
    id,
    event_id,
    attempt_number,
    processing_status,
    qualification_state,
    handoff_status,
    failure_type,
    failure_reason,
    completed_at;

INSERT INTO public.identity_map (
    entity_type,
    product_id,
    hubspot_object_type,
    hubspot_record_id,
    resolution_method
)
VALUES (
    'workspace',
    $1,
    'company',
    $2,
    'stable_id'
)
ON CONFLICT (entity_type, product_id)
DO UPDATE SET
    hubspot_record_id = EXCLUDED.hubspot_record_id,
    resolution_method = EXCLUDED.resolution_method
RETURNING
    entity_type,
    product_id,
    hubspot_object_type,
    hubspot_record_id,
    resolution_method;

UPDATE public.processing_attempts
SET
    processing_status = 'review_required',
    qualification_state = 'needs_review',
    handoff_status = 'review_required',
    failure_type = 'company_identity_not_found',
    failure_reason = 'Workspace could not be resolved to a HubSpot Company',
    completed_at = NOW()
WHERE id = (
    SELECT id
    FROM public.processing_attempts
    WHERE event_id = $1
    ORDER BY attempt_number DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
RETURNING
    id,
    event_id,
    attempt_number,
    processing_status,
    qualification_state,
    handoff_status,
    failure_type,
    failure_reason,
    completed_at;

UPDATE public.processing_attempts
SET
    processing_status = 'review_required',
    qualification_state = 'needs_review',
    handoff_status = 'review_required',
    failure_type = 'company_identity_ambiguous',
    failure_reason = 'Multiple HubSpot Companies matched the workspace identity',
    completed_at = NOW()
WHERE id = (
    SELECT id
    FROM public.processing_attempts
    WHERE event_id = $1
    ORDER BY attempt_number DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
RETURNING
    id,
    event_id,
    attempt_number,
    processing_status,
    qualification_state,
    handoff_status,
    failure_type,
    failure_reason,
    completed_at;
